§01 Executive Summary
The Remaining Requirement Is Execution.
OpenLoop has identified a compelling opportunity to launch Cardi Care, a celebrity-led healthcare platform anchored by Cardi B and powered by OpenLoop's clinical infrastructure.
The infrastructure exists. The product portfolio exists. The economics have been modeled. The market opportunity is validated.
IAM proposes to serve as the execution partner responsible for structuring, negotiating, launching, managing, and scaling the Cardi Care deal from engagement through launch and growth. OpenLoop remains focused on what it does best: clinical delivery, compliance, provider operations, pharmacy relationships, billing, technology, and healthcare infrastructure. IAM manages the work required to turn the Cardi B opportunity into a successful consumer healthcare brand.
Our role is direct:
  • —Secure and manage the Cardi B talent relationship
  • —Structure and negotiate the Cardi Care partnership
  • —Coordinate LOI and definitive agreement execution
  • —Build and launch the Cardi Care brand
  • —Manage creative, marketing, acquisition, and growth
  • —Serve as Agency of Record and operating partner for Cardi Care
This is not a generic creator-healthcare platform proposal. This is a proposal for IAM to execute the Cardi Care deal.
§02 Why IAM
The Execution Layer.
OpenLoop's Cardi B proposal clearly defines the business opportunity: a jointly held healthcare company offering GLP-1 weight management, female sexual wellness, HRT, and NAD+/peptide therapy, with Cardi B holding 30% equity and OpenLoop holding 51%.
What OpenLoop needs now is the execution layer.
Cardi Care requires successful execution across disciplines outside traditional healthcare infrastructure:
01 Talent acquisition and negotiation
02 Business affairs coordination
03 Compensation and milestone structuring
04 Brand development
05 Consumer positioning
06 Creative production
07 Social and influencer marketing
08 Paid acquisition
09 Stakeholder management
10 Ongoing brand and growth administration
IAM was created to perform these functions. OpenLoop provides healthcare infrastructure. IAM provides the talent, brand, transaction, and growth infrastructure required to get Cardi Care closed, launched, and scaled.
